themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retailer Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Complaints about cannabis retailers spiked to 7 THIS WEEK, a 1020% increase compared to 0.6 per week average over the prior 8 weeks, suggesting rapid illegal retail proliferation or enforcement crackdown in Greenwich Village/SoHo.
evidence: 7 cannabis retailer complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 9.16)
1020% spike represents the highest statistical deviation across all complaint categories
Suggests either new illegal dispensary openings or intensified community reporting
reporting_angles: Investigate whether unlicensed cannabis shops are opening faster than city enforcement can act
Interview residents and business owners in high-complaint blocks to understand what triggered complaints this week

themes_detail.label: Consumer Complaints Jump This Week
themes_detail.summary: Consumer complaints more than doubled to 19 THIS WEEK compared to an 8.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks, a 134% spike that suggests a new consumer protection issue or retail scam affecting the district.
evidence: 19 consumer complaints THIS WEEK vs. 8.1 weekly average (z-score: 4.31)
No granular data available on complaint types, limiting immediate specificity
reporting_angles: Request detailed 311 complaint descriptions from this week to identify common thread (pricing scams, counterfeit goods, delivery fraud, etc.)
Canvass SoHo/Village retail strips to identify problematic vendors or recent business openings

themes_detail.label: Dead Animal & Tree Removal Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints hit 4 LAST WEEK (540% above baseline) and dead/dying tree complaints reached 4 THIS WEEK (700% above baseline), signaling potential sanitation or environmental neglect; combined with repeated budget requests for forestry services, points to systemic maintenance gap.
evidence: 4 dead animal complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average (z-score: 6.97)
4 dead/dying tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average (z-score: 7.0)
Community board has requested forestry services and sanitation truck increases year-over-year, suggesting chronic underfunding
reporting_angles: Investigate whether Parks Dept tree maintenance crew is understaffed or defunded
Check if recent weather events (flooding, storms) contributed to animal deaths and tree damage

themes_detail.label: Illegal Tree Damage & Structural Decay
themes_detail.summary: Illegal tree damage complaints jumped to 7 LAST WEEK, a 331% spike compared to 1.6 weekly baseline, while flooring/stairs complaints spiked 276% two weeks ago; both suggest either developer activity damaging infrastructure or deferred maintenance on older buildings.
evidence: 7 illegal tree damage complaints LAST WEEK vs. 1.6 weekly average (z-score: 5.42)
8 flooring/stairs complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 2.1 weekly average (z-score: 6.34)
1,758 building alteration permits filed in last 90 days (1,522 alterations + 151 alteration COs), highest volume since data collection began
reporting_angles: Cross-reference illegal tree damage 311 complaints with DOB permits to determine if construction projects are uprooting protected trees
Examine flooring/stairs complaints against building violations database to identify which properties have code issues

themes_detail.label: Real-Time Enforcement Actions Surge
themes_detail.summary: Real-time enforcement complaints increased to 11 THIS WEEK, a 175% jump from 4.0 weekly average, possibly indicating aggressive vendor or parking crackdowns or increased illegal activity triggering street-level enforcement responses.
evidence: 11 real-time enforcement complaints THIS WEEK vs. 4.0 weekly average (z-score: 3.74)
Follows high baseline complaints in illegal parking (1,171 total) and vendor enforcement (363 total), suggesting concentrated enforcement activity
reporting_angles: Determine whether enforcement is reactive (responding to complaints) or proactive (planned operation)
Interview street vendors and residents to assess whether enforcement is perceived as fair or excessive
